newsitem.title: BULGARIA: SOCCER-BULGARIA WITHOUT STOICHKOV AGAINST LUXEMBOURG.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BULGARIA WITHOUT STOICHKOV AGAINST LUXEMBOURG.

text.p: Volatile striker Hristo Stoichkov, who did not turn up for Bulgaria's World Cup qualifier against Israel last month, was on Tuesday left out of the squad for next week's European group five match against Luxembourg.
Coach Hristo Bonev made no reference to Stoichkov when he announced the squad. The Barcelona player has recently been sidelined by a leg injury.
Bonev has dropped defenders Gosho Ginchev and Vladimir Ivanov and included two uncapped players, defender Georgi Antonov and striker Georgi Markov, both from Lokomotiv Sofia.
Bulgaria lost 2-1 in their opening qualifying match in Israel last month and will be desperately keen to take all three points from their visit to Luxembourg next Tuesday.

Squad - Borislav Mihailov, Zdravko Zdravkov, Tsanko Tsvetanov, Trifon Ivanov, Radostin Kishishev, Ivan Vassilev, Georgi Antonov, Zlatko Yankov, Yordan Lechkov, Krasimir Balakov, Daniel Borimirov, Ivailo Yordanov, Kostadin Vidolov, Marian Hristov, Alexander Alexandrov, Emil Kostadinov, Georgi Donkov, Georgi Markov, Georgi Ivanov, Roumen Hristov.
